analysis:
Market regime is MIXED: SPY sits 1.9% below its SMA50 but the 20-day slope remains positive at +0.47%, meaning the tape is consolidating rather than rolling over. This is not an all-clear environment and caution is warranted on new buys.

EXISTING POSITION REVIEW: ADSK (+5.1%) and ULTA (+6.2%) are working well — theses intact, no action needed. UHS (+1.96%) is flat but still within a healthy base; hold. FOXA (-3.82%) is treading water; not a thesis break, but worth watching given media sector uncertainty — stop discipline in place. AMP (-7.83%) is the most concerning: Ameriprise is down nearly 8% from cost. At 19 shares × $504 = $9,582 it is the smallest position by dollar value, but the loss is meaningful. No news of fundamental thesis break is visible, but if price breaches the $490–495 zone (approximately 10–11% from cost, near a natural support level), I would treat that as a stop trigger. Watch closely this week.

NEW BUY CAPACITY: Only ~$20,500 of headroom remains before hitting the 95% gross-cap. That limits any new position to one modest-sized trade. The bar must therefore be high: genuinely asymmetric setup, not manufacturing activity.

BEST CANDIDATE — NXPI: NXP Semiconductors sits at 51% of its 52-week range in a confirmed uptrend basing pattern — the ideal Stage 1→2 transition zone per the strategy. Fundamentally it is the cheapest high-quality name on the screen: PEG 0.52, forward P/E 14, ROE 28.7%, op margin 32.3%, revenue growth 19.3%, and FCF of $4.1B. EPS revisions are modestly positive (+1.4%). The automotive/industrial semiconductor exposure creates some cyclical risk, but the valuation more than compensates. Technically, price is 10% above SMA50 (acceptable off a base) with SMA50 slope positive — not yet extended. No earnings date is listed within the near-term window, removing event risk. With the limited headroom, position sized conservatively at ~$20,300 (79 shares), risking ~1.4% of equity to the stop. Other tempting candidates (TXN, ADI, AAPL) are >85% of 52w range and explicitly avoided per rules. WDAY and ADI have earnings in ~21 days — binary event risk. The rest of the candidate list lacks the combination of valuation, trend confirmation, and available headroom to justify a trade today. Cash retained as a deliberate position.

Thesis-break triggers requiring earlier exit: (1) sustained break below SMA200 on weekly close, (2) significant negative EPS revision cycle (>5% cut), (3) sector-wide semiconductor demand warning from a major peer. Time stop: reassess if no meaningful progress toward target within 90 days. Trail stop up by 1x ATR increments as trade works.
